title: Custom Handler integration with the Permission API
body:
I wonder whether there would be interest on adding a new sub-section in the [Custom scheme handler](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/system-state.html#custom-handlers) section (at the same level than the one about Security and privacy) regarding the integration with the Permission API. 

In this subsection we would define a new [PermissionName](https://w3c.github.io/permissions/#dom-permissiondescriptor-name) to be used in a [PermssionDescriptor](https://w3c.github.io/permissions/#dom-permissiondescriptor) and how it would be used to determine the behavior currently specified for the _registerProtocolHandler_ method:

> User agents may, within the constraints described, do whatever they like. A user agent could, for instance, prompt the user and offer the user the opportunity to add the site to a shortlist of handlers, or make the handlers their default, or cancel the request. User agents could also silently collect the information, providing it only when relevant to the user.

The main use case I had in mind would be to provide support for [Automated testing](https://w3c.github.io/permissions/#automation) through the extension commands for the WebDriver specification. 
- Requirements:
  - A new PermissionName to be included in the Permission IDL used by the engines
  - A list of valid states; I believe allowing just ASK is what would match better in the currently specified behavior
  - A description of cases were protocols may be registered / unregistered silently
  - It must be compatible with the [SetPermission](https://w3c.github.io/permissions/#set-permission-command) extension command 

There are other specs with similar sections, like the [Persistence permission ](https://storage.spec.whatwg.org/#persistence), [Geolocation user consent](https://www.w3.org/TR/geolocation/#user-consent) or [Clipboard Permission API integration](https://w3c.github.io/clipboard-apis/#clipboard-permissions).
